title: Web UI: locate active task + new-added-tasks section + in-progress highlight fix
description:
Web UI dashboard improvements (3 sub-features), all in packages/plan-web-ui/src:

1. Header active-task → locate in work-tree:
   - app-shell.tsx ActiveTasksHeader (line ~11): each task row is a <Link> to task-detail. Add a separate locate icon button (stopPropagation) that navigates to /?locate=T00x (query param, not hash — survives refresh, no '/' issues).
   - work-tree.tsx + use-dashboard-tree.ts: read ?locate=T00x, find task by number, force-expand feature+phase, scrollIntoView the task row + pulse ap-search-hit ~3s, clear param.
   - work-tree-rows.tsx TaskTreeRow (line ~306): add id={`task-row-${task.number}`} on the row container for scroll target.

2. New Added Tasks section (new component new-added-tasks.tsx):
   - Mirror latest-completed-tasks.tsx structure. Tasks with createdAt < 3min (NEW_TASK_WINDOW_MS=180000), sorted desc. Hide section entirely when empty (transient, not permanent). Single setTimeout for expiry (no per-row polling).
   - dashboard/route.tsx: mount <NewAddedTasks> after <LatestCompletedTasks> (line 57).

3. In-progress highlight fix (work-tree-rows.tsx lines 99, 201):
   - Current: ${hasActiveTask ? "ap-in-progress" : feature.status === "in-progress" ? "border orange bg" : ""} — the status-only branch colors orange WITH border even when no task is actually in-progress.
   - ap-progress-glow keyframe (base.css:276) = animated inset orange border + glow. ap-in-progress (base.css:288) gated on hasActiveTask already.
   - Fix: remove the `: feature.status === "in-progress" ? "..."` and `: phase.status === "in-progress" ? "..."` static-orange branches → orange ONLY when hasActiveTask (genuine active task). Task row (line 308) keeps task.status === "in-progress" (a task IS the active unit).

Behaviors preserved: ap-in-progress glow on hasActiveTask; recentlyChanged ring; ap-search-hit highlight; DnD (id on SortableItem wrapper, anchor id on inner row — different elements); done opacity styling.

Stack: React + TypeScript, react-router useSearchParams/useNavigate, lucide-react icon.

tasks.title: Locate active task should expand only the branch containing the task
tasks.description:
When clicking the target/locate icon for an in-progress task in the header, the current locate effect sets treeOpenMode('all'), which expands every feature/phase. User wants only the specific feature and phase containing the target task to expand, keeping the rest of the tree untouched.

Code references:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx (locate effect)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/hooks/use-dashboard-tree.ts (treeOpenMode and expansion state setters)

Acceptance:
- Clicking the target icon navigates to dashboard with ?locate=T00x.
- Only the feature containing the task and the phase containing the task expand.
- Other features/phases keep their current expansion state.
- Filters that would hide the task are still cleared.
- Scroll and pulse behavior remain.
- Build and copy bundle pass.

---
**Completion summary:**
Updated locate-in-work-tree effect in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx to use treeOpenMode('smart') instead of 'all'. Now clicking the target icon for an active task expands only the feature and phase containing that task, leaving the rest of the tree in its current state. Filters that would hide the task are still cleared. Scroll and pulse behavior remain. Built and copied bundle.
